messages:
Alex: Quick heads up — procurement flagged a 5d delay on one H100 batch. Affects 8 reserved slots for customer-42. Can owners weigh in on mitigation? :eyes:
Maria: Ugh. Which PO / shipment ID? Is ETA +5 days exact or tentative?
Alex: PO# 98432, shipment ID S-2026-04-H100. ETA moved from 2026-03-22 -> 2026-03-27. Confirmed by vendor.
Devon: Do we have any spare dedicated nodes we can temporarily reassign? Or spin up cloud fallback for low-priv traffic?
Sam: We have 2 spare nodes in staging only. Production pool is fully committed for this month. We could reshuffle non-critical reservations, but need confirmation from customers.
Alex: Okay — short plan: 1) try to borrow 2 production nodes from lower-priority reservations, 2) route non-sensitive workloads to hosted for the 5d window, 3) run quick smoke on any reassigned node.
Julia: I can run the smoke and KV-cache validation. Will need the smoke script and a target node name.
Alex: Quick command to run once a node is available — paste into the infra runbook: ```kubectl exec -it smoke-test -- /bin/bash -c "python3 smoke_runner.py --target node-XYZ --tests kv_prefix,throughput,latency"```
ops-bot: Reservation system update: 2 nodes with label `prod-spare` available for 24h (expires 1799080000).
Maria: Who's going to own customer comms? We need to offer a mitigation timeline + optional credits if their SLA is impacted.
Devon: I can take outreach for customer-42. Will draft message: short summary + proposed fallback + credit offer. Tagging legal if needed.
Sam: Firmware / maintenance windows — we have a queued firmware patch next week. We should avoid applying it during any reassignments. Who owns the patch window?
Alex: Patch window is owned by infra-ops (Sam), but we can push to next week if that helps. For now: Sam owns firmware scheduling, Devon owns customer comms, Julia owns smoke runs. I'll own routing config changes.
Julia: I'll run the smoke at T+8h and post logs in this thread. If I see KV misses, I'll revert the reassignment.
Alex: Great — action items: Devon -> message customer-42 within 2h, Sam -> hold firmware if reassignment occurs, Julia -> smoke + logs, Alex -> routing change plan + PR.
Maria: Thanks. Please ping me when the customer note is ready, I'll approve credits if needed. :thumbsup: 
Alex: Thanks everyone — please update status in this thread as tasks complete. Closing loop shortly. :rocket:
